messages:
Emily Chen: Handoff note for the Optimize toolkit pilot (AcmeHealth). Need to lock batching/caching/quant defaults before canary. 15-min sync at 15:30 PT?
Jason Patel: I can. Key decisions: adaptive batch caps, KV TTL default, quant profiles.
María Gómez: Field team wants clear acceptance criteria they can run against.
Ankit Rao: Recommend adaptive batching max=64, target=32, safety fallback to max=8 if p99>300ms over 5m.
Liu Wei: KV cache default TTL=30m, per-route override. Tag telemetry by tenant to measure hit-rate.
Samir K: Quant: expose INT8-fast for cost lane, FP16 fallback. Add INT8-deterministic opt-in for Dedicated/Private.
Emily Chen: Proposed gates: Pilot: AcmeHealth only, adaptive batching, TTL=30m, INT8-fast enabled with auto-fallback to FP16 if eval delta>2%. GA: 2w stable, >=20% token-cost reduction, no critical error increase, SLOs met.
Jason Patel: Make failover automatic per-tenant on eval alert. Add canary eval at 30m and 6h. Abort if eval delta>1.5% at 30m.
María Gómez: Runbook: who to page (on-call + product lead), verify KMS and audit logs for AcmeHealth.
Liu Wei: Dashboard panels needed: batch size histogram, p50/p95/p99, KV hit rate, token-cost delta, eval-concordance.
Ankit Rao: I'll open PR for routing policy + audit log events.
Samir K: I'll draft INT8-deterministic doc with perf/variance notes.
Dena (deploy-bot): Canary scheduled: 5% tenants at 03:00 UTC, 12h ramp.
Emily Chen: Action list: Jason+Ankit auto-fallback+canary hooks, Liu dashboards, Samir quant doc, María pilot acceptance doc. Sync at 15:30 PT. :thumbsup:
